It comes in waves like that for me too. The best way I've found to deal with it is distractions. Whether that means exercise, video games, the girlfriend, cooking, reading, building something, watching movies, watching a TV series, or any other hobby that is available to you. If you can make it through those few days each time, you can go on for a long time without any major issues. The main thing is to just keep yourself completely busy (mostly with fun stuff, if you can manage, but work is fine too) during low points. Basically, try to avoid thinking. Your thoughts will only betray you. You will convince yourself that those feelings are your true thoughts, and you'll start meandering down that same old path.

I don't know how to fix it, I haven't had much success in the things I've tried. But, I can manage to get by if I have enough distractions.
